notes.49: Seeds rand() with the rank, so each worker gets its own tag.
notes.50: A tag from 0 to 49. Different ranks will usually get different tags.
notes.53: The tag is no longer 0. The receiver can read it from status.
notes.60: Accepts a message from any sender with any tag. status will say which message it was.
notes.62: status.MPI_TAG: the tag it was sent with.
notes.64: MPI_Get_count: how many MPI_CHARs actually arrived (not the buffer size of 100).
notes.68: Prints the greeting that arrived. With wildcards, the order can differ from run to run.

summaries.all: Same shape as mpi_hello.c. The difference is how rank 0 receives.
summaries.zero: Rank 0 prints its own greeting, then makes {m} wildcard receive(s). Whichever worker's message arrives first is handled first.
summaries.worker: Rank {r} sends one greeting to rank 0 using a tag taken from rand() % 50.
